This plot is for beans and other legumes, intercropped. Beans do not need the chemical fertilizer the way maize does — they take their own goodness from the air into the soil. Whatever FISP coupons I can find will go to my maize plot, not here. I will use seeds I saved from last harvest, like my father did, and my family will do the weeding ourselves. We cannot afford to hire many people for beans.
